name: StartHost
transaction_boundary: no transaction spans startup; each migration has its own atomic boundary and runtime registry publication is external technical state
authoritative_reads: accepted migration manifest and current database/ledger
idempotency: launcher operation is serialized by exclusive instance lock/run identity; a second launch never becomes a second authoritative host
receipt_order: not a domain command receipt flow; startup technical evidence is instance lock + migration ledger + run identity/runtime registry
mutations: initial/migration database state through MigrationRunner when required
revision_effects: only migrations change persisted schema/ledger revisions; startup itself does not change domain revisions
audit_action: none; StartHost uses technical startup evidence defined by audit/actions.json and does not fabricate application audit
post_commit_work: publish runtime registry, authenticated self-health, report READY; browser launch remains LLD-12/launcher responsibility
